Built for Instantaneous Discovery

Engineered to outpace bloated JavaScript SPA directories with raw static performance.

Sub-50ms First Contentful Paint

Zero external JavaScript frameworks or bloated CSS libraries. The directory ships raw semantic HTML5 with inline scoped styling, guaranteeing immediate rendering on low-bandwidth mobile devices and high-end workstations alike.

Crawler & LLM-First Structure

Full JSON-LD ItemList schema coupled with semantic markup enables instant semantic comprehension by OpenAI GPTBot, Anthropic ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and PerplexityBot without executing client-side scripts.

Zero-Network Faceted Filtering

Instant search and multi-tag filtering operate in-memory on pre-rendered DOM elements. Experience 0ms latency when typing, toggling categories, or filtering by Free vs Freemium pricing models.
